source: Programmer's Guide For PLS300 (Analog Way; device type 78), 51 pages, recovered from the ManualsLib text layer 2026-09-13

transport.error_frame: E<code>; 10=invalid command, 11=index value out of range, 12=wrong index count
transport.push: after any accepted command the device sends the status of every parameter that changed
notes: Commands need no terminator: the mnemonic itself ends the command.
Mnemonics are one or two letters and case-sensitive (NC and Nc are different variables).
LANENABLE (ne) defaults to 0 = RS232 only; LAN must be enabled on the front panel first.
LANPROTOCOL (nt) is exclusive: 0 = UDP, 1 = TCP (default), 2 = AMX.
RS232 is 9600 baud 8N1 by default (STANDBY group selects the rate).
